rega-rb330.model: RB330 tonearm (9 in, Rega geometry: 222 mm from the platter's centre to the arm's hole, effective length 236.5, overhang 14.5, offset 21.55 deg), with its own lead and cueing lift
rega-rb330.supplier: Safe and Sound HQ (US); Home Cinema Solutions $698
rega-rb330.note: the mounting hole and the plinth thickness it takes are in Rega's RB330 manual (arm mounting data; https://phonophono.de/mwdownloads/download/link/id/921), not read: confirm the 24 hole and the 40 mm of acrylic under its nut, or counterbore from below

ortofon-2m-blue.model: 2M Blue moving-magnet cartridge (nude elliptical stylus, 5.5 mV), 1/2 in mount
ortofon-2m-blue.note: a moving-magnet cartridge so any phono stage serves; the 2M Bronze or a Hana SL (moving coil) are the step up

rega-24v-motor.model: 24 V low-vibration synchronous motor upgrade kit (motor, its board and mounting), for the Neo PSU
rega-24v-motor.note: the motor's size and shaft are not published in what was read: the pod's bore (56) and the pulley's bore wait on the motor in hand; sold through Rega dealers

rega-neo-psu-mk2.model: Neo PSU MK2: DSP-generated drive for Rega's 24 V motor, 33/45 by a button, fine speed trim (0.01 rpm steps) on the back; US 60 Hz 115-120 V version
rega-neo-psu-mk2.note: the speed changes without moving the belt, so the pulley has one diameter; the box stands beside the record player (or under it, on the shelf)

flat-belt.model: Flat turntable belt, ground rubber or polyurethane, 5 wide x 0.6, about 975 long unstretched (1025 round the platter's rim and the 40 pulley, stretched 5 %)
flat-belt.supplier: a turntable belt maker (cut to length)

bearing-bushes.model: Oil-impregnated sintered bronze plain bushes 10 x 14 x 12, a pair (Oilite kind), reamed to a 0.01 running fit on the spindle after pressing

carbide-ball.model: Tungsten carbide ball, 6 mm, grade 10: the spindle's thrust point, seated in a cup at the spindle's foot

thrust-pad.model: Thrust pad, PTFE (or PEEK), 13.8 x 2, at the bottom of the housing's bore, under the ball

bearing-oil.model: Turntable bearing oil, 8 ml (a light synthetic oil, ISO VG 32 or as the bush maker says)

sorbothane-feet.model: Sorbothane hemispheres or discs, 44 across, 6 tall, Shore 50 or 70 (chosen by the loaded weight, about 2 kg a foot), a set of 3, bonded under the plinth's feet

sorbothane-pod.model: Sorbothane discs 25 x 6, Shore 30, a set of 3, under the motor's pod (about 0.6 kg on them: soft, so the motor's hum stays in the pod)

feet-studs.model: Three M8 brass threaded inserts bonded with epoxy into the plinth's bottom sheet (12.5 holes, 15 deep), three M8 x 30 brass studs and lock nuts: the feet turn on them to level the platter

bearing-fixings.model: Three M4 brass threaded inserts bonded with epoxy into 6 holes in the pocket's floor, three M4 x 10 black socket button heads: the bearing's flange

acrylic-cement-small.model: Two-part polymerising acrylic cement for cast sheet (Acrifix 1R 0192 kind), clear: the cemented layers (a 100 g kit does one piece)

laser-etch-small.model: Laser etching into the cast acrylic, frosted, about 0.1 deep, from a vector file: EARF 44 wide, the etch filled with the colour, deeper
laser-etch-small.supplier: a laser-cutting shop with an engraver

centric-warm-strip.model: CENTRIC WARM LED strip, 24 V, 95+ CRI, 2700 K at full and dimming warmer toward 2000 K (PN 3008.27), 450 lm a foot; 0.40 m a lamp (two turns round the hub, 64 across, cut at its marks)
centric-warm-strip.supplier: Waveform Lighting (US), sold by the reel
centric-warm-strip.note: datasheet CS_3008.27 (https://store.waveformlighting.com/cdn/shop/files/CS_3008.27.pdf): its watts a foot and its cut length not read; about 620 lm a lamp at full; the reel price not seen (the FilmGrade 16 ft reel is $109)

rotary-dimmer.model: Single Color Mini Rotary Dimmer, 12-24 V DC PWM, with an on/off switch at the end of its turn, 2.1 mm plug in; its board taken out of the housing and screwed into the foot's pocket, the knob replaced by the acrylic one
rotary-dimmer.note: not a listed part once out of its housing: for sale, a listed 24 V dimmer to fit the same pocket (an open question)

meanwell-gst25u24.model: GST25U24-P1J wall-plug adapter, 24 V DC 1.04 A (25 W), level VI, its 2.1 mm plug on a 1.5 m lead; limited power source by one listing
meanwell-gst25u24.note: price not shown in what was read; the desktop GST25A24-P1J is $19.42 at IBS Electronics

clear-cord.model: 18/2 SPT-2 lamp cord, clear (80-2374), 8 ft: from the foot's back to a 2.1 mm in-line DC socket for the adapter, and on up the stem to the hub (low voltage only)

dc-socket.model: In-line 2.1 x 5.5 mm DC socket with strain relief, for the cord's end

cord-grip.model: Clear nylon strain-relief bush for 18/2 SPT-2 cord in a 9.5 hole (Heyco kind)

bumpons-clear.model: Bumpon SJ5302 clear hemispherical bumpers 11 x 5, a set of 6 (under the foot)

lamp-fixings.model: The lamp's screws: three M4 x 12 black button heads and M4 brass inserts bonded in the hub's flange (the shade's collar), four M3 x 8 and inserts (the foot's cover), two M3 x 6 (the dimmer's board), black nylon washers

thermal-tape.model: The strip's own adhesive on the hub, and 3M 8810 thermally conductive tape at the hub's bore round the cord's exit

felt-pad-ring.model: Silicone ring gasket 1 mm, cut to the shade's collar (68 x 92), so the formed collar is clamped without stress
